Extremely disappointing experience, especially considering the reputation and price of this place.

We chose this groomer because of the excellent reviews and specifically asked beforehand if they had experience grooming Miniature Schnauzers. They assured us they did.

When we picked our dog up, they immediately admitted they had “made a mistake.” One entire side of his body had been cut extremely short and unevenly, while the other was left noticeably longer. The overall Schnauzer cut was poorly shaped, the hair around his tail and legs was uneven, and his ears were not properly finished. I actually had to explain how I wanted his ears corrected.

What disappointed us most was how they handled the situation. Instead of simply taking responsibility, they repeatedly made excuses. They said Meco was a nine-month-old puppy (he is 14 months old, and they had his information), that his hair had never been cut before, and that he still had “puppy hair.” In reality, this was his fourth haircut, and his previous one had been done by a professional groomer just two months earlier, so his Schnauzer cut was still clearly shaped when we brought him in.

When we asked them to fix it, they kept asking us where and how much they should cut instead of confidently proposing a professional solution themselves.

They did offer to correct the haircut once his hair grows back, but after this experience we obviously won’t be returning. Unfortunately, because one side was cut so extremely short, we’ll now have to wait months for the hair in that area to fully grow back.

Mistakes can happen, but for a groomer at this price point that specifically assured us they knew how to groom Schnauzers, we expected much more expertise, professionalism, and accountability. We left very disappointed and will not be coming back.

I had a horrible experience trying to drop off my pup for his last grooming appointment. I’ve been bringing him to Pet Story since he was a baby, for almost two years, which is why I continued going despite having approximately six negative interactions there.

Unfortunately, several of those experiences involved Irene and some front desk staff. I had already started trying to avoid certain employees and request other groomers because the way I was treated seemed to depend entirely on who was working. Irene, in particular, has repeatedly insisted that my dog needed to be shaved, while other groomers there have been willing to actually groom him without shaving him down.

As a dog owner, it can be difficult and stressful to suddenly change places so for a long time, I tried to overlook these experiences because my pup had been going there since he was little. I literally remember thinking, “Six bad experiences over almost two years… I can still do this.” But it became extremely stressful feeling like I had to figure out who was working or avoid certain people just so I wouldn’t be mistreated.

During our most recent visit, everything escalated. A manager became extremely rude and yelled at me so loudly that everyone was looking. While this was happening, Irene and the manager began pulling through my pup’s hair very roughly.

I remember watching how forcefully they were pulling through his hair and thinking, “Wow, that looks extremely hard,” while wondering if that was really necessary. At the same time, I was in shock because I was also being yelled at.

I ended up leaving and taking my pup to another groomer nearby without an appointment. The difference was shocking.

They were kind and professional, did a beautiful job, and my pup was ready in about an hour—without needing to be shaved. They have a sitting area with windows where customers can observe the whole process, so after have been treated extremely badly at Pet Story I decided to stay and watch.

The groomers at the other place were gentle with my puppy. They did not tell me that his coat was in “bad shape,” they did not tell me that he needed to be shaved, and I watched them brush through his hair gently and without the force I had just witnessed at Pet Story.

Seeing both experiences within less than an hour was honestly SHOCKING. I went from watching my dog’s hair being pulled through very roughly while being told there was a serious problem, to watching another professional grooming team calmly and gently brush him without any issues.

My pup has seemed scared to go inside Pet Story a lot and I used to assume that was normal nervousness about grooming but  after seeing how roughly he was handled directly in front of me, it has made me very concerned about what his experiences there may have been like.

I tried for a long time to overlook the way I was treated because I wanted consistency for my puppy. But after this last experience, the level of disrespect and the stress of wondering who will be working, how I will be treated, and now how my puppy may be treated has become too much.

Unfortunately, Pet Story has lost a long-time customer. I’ve brought my dog here for nearly two years with a consistent weight and grooming fee.

At drop-off, the groomer weighed her in front of me, said nothing about a price change, and had me sign the grooming consent form. Only after grooming had begun did the front desk call to say the price had increased due to her weight. When I explained that her weight hadn’t changed, I was told it was probably recorded incorrectly in the past.

I don’t object to reasonable price increases or weight-based pricing. I object to being informed only after the service was underway, when her weight was known at check-in. Offering to have me pick her up mid-groom was also not a reasonable solution.

The shop does good grooming, which makes this especially disappointing. Pricing changes should be communicated before a service begins, not halfway through it.

I’m genuinely sad to be writing this review. I have been a loyal client of Pet Story since they opened, for about two years, and until now I had continued coming back and trusting them with my pup.

Unfortunately, a recent interaction with one of the managers completely changed how I feel about this place. While I was simply trying to provide feedback, he raised his voice at me and would not even allow me to finish speaking. I was shocked and extremely uncomfortable with the way I was treated.

Today I had to return for a small retouch for my pup, and I realized how much that incident had affected me. I felt genuinely uncomfortable just walking back into the store.

I understand that misunderstandings can happen in any business, but I don’t believe a customer should ever be yelled at or made to feel intimidated. After supporting this business for two years, it is incredibly disappointing and upsetting to feel that I can no longer comfortably walk through their doors.
